title: Meat industry lobbying and Germany's animal-husbandry labelling law
scope_note: Public-source investigation. The case maps documented advocacy, affiliations and legislative changes. It does not infer corruption, improper influence or causation without evidence.

sources.title: PFG Central Services GmbH & Co.KG — Lobbyregister entry
sources.source_type: primary self-disclosure hosted by official authority
supports: PFG reports lobbying expenditure of EUR 190,001–200,000 for FY2025 and 3.00 FTE.
PFG lists membership in the meat-industry association and Wirtschaftsrat der CDU among four memberships.
sources.does_not_prove: Membership or expenditure does not prove policy outcomes or improper influence.

sources.title: PFG regulatory project — revision of TierHaltKennzG
sources.source_type: primary self-disclosure hosted by official authority
supports: PFG disclosed that it wanted the planned 1 August 2025 labelling obligation not to take effect before a practical revision of the law.
sources.does_not_prove: This proves an advocacy objective, not that PFG caused any later amendment.

sources.title: Verband der Fleischwirtschaft e.V. (VDF) — Lobbyregister entry
sources.source_type: primary self-disclosure hosted by official authority
sources.exact_location: Financial expenditure; members; memberships; concrete regulatory projects
supports: VDF reports EUR 140,001–150,000 in lobbying expenditure for FY2025 and 1.40 FTE.
VDF reports 120 members and nine concrete regulatory projects.
VDF lists memberships including Wirtschaftsrat der CDU and Wirtschaftsforum der SPD.
sources.does_not_prove: Association membership does not establish direction, control, donations or improper political influence.

sources.title: VDF position on amendment of TierHaltKennzG
sources.exact_location: Regelungsvorhaben RV0026526 · statements SG2606300402 and SG2606300404
supports: VDF registered a project seeking a practical, EU-law-compatible amendment of the animal-husbandry labelling law.
The linked statements were sent to Bundestag actors and/or the federal government.
sources.does_not_prove: Sending a position paper proves access/advocacy, not adoption of its proposals.

sources.title: VDF statement SG2606300402
sources.exact_location: Addressed 30 Apr 2026 to Bundestag parliamentary groups/members, Federal Chancellery and BMLEH
supports: A VDF position on the law was sent to named categories of federal decision-makers.
sources.does_not_prove: Receipt does not prove persuasion, agreement or legislative causation.

sources.title: Bundestag printed paper 21/327 — First Act amending TierHaltKennzG
sources.exact_location: p.1 Problem/Solution; p.5 §40(2); p.7 Executive footprint
supports: The bill proposed extending the transition deadline from 1 Aug 2025 to 1 Mar 2026.
The explanatory text refers to signals/reactions from affected economic actors and the Länder agriculture ministers.
The executive footprint says interest representatives did not materially contribute to the bill's content.
sources.does_not_prove: Policy alignment with a disclosed lobbying objective is not proof that the lobbyist caused the change.

sources.title: VDF member overview
sources.exact_location: Member list includes Premium Food Group, Westfleisch and Vion entities
supports: Major meat-sector companies are listed by the association as members.
sources.does_not_prove: Membership does not mean every member directed or endorsed every VDF lobbying position.

sources.title: PFG position on third amendment of TierHaltKennzG
supports: PFG disclosed objectives including downgrading and labelling of imported goods in the next amendment.
sources.does_not_prove: The registered request does not establish that those requested provisions will be adopted.
